messages:
Riley: Quick policy check 1: candidate accepted, start date 12/20 (mid-pay period). How do we prorat e PTO accrual for their first month and do we allow them to use a bridge day for 12/22 holiday coverage? Need language for offer.

Olivia (People Ops): For proration, we pro-rate PTO accruals by days worked in the first calendar month unless local law says otherwise. So starting 12/20 they'd get (days worked/total days in month) of the monthly accrual. Do not promise immediate full-month accrual.

Jordan (Hiring): Got it. Candidate asked if they can take a paid bridge day on 12/22 (company holiday week) before their first full month completes. Any flexibility?

Olivia (People Ops): Bridge-day exceptions for new hires are allowed case-by-case. We generally require manager approval + a short note in the exception ticket. For hires who start right before a holiday, managers can grant a single unpaid or discretionary paid day at their discretion (Finance must approve paid).

Marcus (Finance): Finance note: paid bridge day for a new hire is a discretionary grant. If manager requests paid, we need a one-off budget code and written approval before payroll cutoff. Otherwise mark as unpaid in the offer. Cutoff for December payroll adjustments: 12/15.

Riley: So offer wording should avoid promising paid bridge day. Maybe: "Eligible for pro-rated PTO; bridge-day requests considered as discretionary and require manager and Finance approval." Good?

Olivia (People Ops): That wording works. Add: "exceptions must be requested via people-ops ticket and approved prior to start/payroll cutoff."

Jordan (Hiring): Also checking carryover: if someone starts mid-December, do they get carryover eligibility that year?

Olivia (People Ops): Carryover eligibility is based on full-year employment and company policy. New hires in their first year are not typically eligible to carry over the same-year accrual. We can make rare exceptions with manager+People Ops approval, but don't promise it in offers.

people-ops-bot: New exception ticket created #HR-2028-101 1: please attach manager approval if requesting paid bridge day. Triage in 2 business days.

Riley: Thanks all. I'll update the offer: conservative on paid bridge day, include proration formula and exception path.

Olivia (People Ops): Thanks. Ping me after you update the offer and before sending to candidate so we can confirm payroll timelines.
